summary: Describes the Selectively Reliable Multicast Protocol, a transport protocol for any-to-any multicast that mixes reliable and best-effort messages. It is meant for distributed simulation, where only the latest reliable value for each data identifier needs delivery, and the application picks which messages are reliable. It is an experimental protocol.

eli5.summary: A group chat where most messages can get lost, but a few important ones must arrive. Chatter carries hints that help spot missing important ones.
